answer: An AI-agent marketplace grants one daily bid slot to each public key that escrows $200 for at least 30 days. The ledger binds every deposit to one key and rejects reuse: shale, sparrow, and lagoon need $600 locked, even if one attacker controls all three. Each additional fake identity therefore ties up another $200. Since the stake is refundable, its marginal cost is financing that lock—about $1.97 per 30 days at an assumed 12% annual rate—plus transaction fees.
